title: Open Coffee equipment catalog
description: Coffee equipment models (machines, grinders, brewers, kettles, scales and accessories) as sold, not individual owned items. Measurements put the unit in the property name. Part of Roastbook Open Coffee; derived from the Roastbook journal gear model.

$schema.description: Canonical URL of the schema version this file follows.

type.title: Equipment type
type.description: espresso_machine_with_grinder is an espresso machine with a built-in grinder; filter covers paper and metal filters; accessory covers everything without a dedicated type (puck screens, distribution tools, thermometers, dosing cups).

heating_architecture.description: How the machine heats water. single_boiler: one boiler for brewing and steam, used in turn; heat_exchanger: one steam boiler that heats brew water passing through a pipe inside it; dual_boiler: separate brew and steam boilers; multi_boiler: more than two boilers, for example one per group; single_thermoblock and dual_thermoblock: water heated on the fly in one or two thermoblocks; hybrid: a boiler combined with a thermoblock; manual: no heater, you pour in hot water.

temperature_control.description: How brew temperature is set. none: no control; fixed: set at the factory; adjustable: the user can change it (for example with a PID); programmable: can change during the shot or follow profiles.

pressure_control.description: How brew pressure is set. fixed: set by the factory; adjustable_opv: the over-pressure valve can be adjusted; manual: controlled by hand, for example with a lever; programmable: follows set pressure profiles.

flow_control.description: Whether water flow during the shot can be controlled. none: no control; manual: by hand, for example a needle valve paddle; programmable: follows set profiles.

preinfusion_control.description: Wetting the coffee at low pressure before full pressure. none: no preinfusion; supported: possible by hand or by technique; fixed: built in with a fixed duration; adjustable: duration or pressure can be set; programmable: part of a programmable profile.

steam_system.description: How milk steam is produced. none: no steam wand; shared_heater: the same heater as for brewing, so the machine switches between modes; dedicated_heater: a separate boiler or thermoblock for steam.

simultaneous_brew_and_steam.description: Whether you can pull a shot and steam milk at the same time. true: possible; false: confirmed not possible; absent: unknown.

pump_type.description: How pressure is made. vibration: small vibratory pump; rotary: quieter rotary vane pump; gear: gear pump, often used for flow profiling; peristaltic: squeezed-tube pump; manual: lever or hand pump, no motor.

water_source_modes.description: Where water comes from. reservoir: a tank you fill; plumbed: connected to the mains water supply.

shot_stop_modes.description: How a shot can be stopped. manual: by the user; weight: automatically at a target weight with a scale; time: after a set time; volume: after a set volume (volumetric dosing).

group_count.description: Number of brew groups (where portafilters lock in), for example 1 for most home machines.

portafilter_diameter_mm.description: Inner diameter of the portafilter basket in millimetres, for example 58.

brew_pressure_min_bar.description: Lowest brew pressure the machine can deliver, in bar.

brew_pressure_max_bar.description: Highest brew pressure the machine can deliver, in bar.

brew_temperature_min_celsius.description: Lowest brew water temperature that can be set, in degrees Celsius.

brew_temperature_max_celsius.description: Highest brew water temperature that can be set, in degrees Celsius.

reservoir_capacity_ml.description: Size of the water tank in millilitres.

group_type.description: Type of brew group. e61: the classic heated E61 group; saturated: group filled with boiler water and kept at its temperature; semi_saturated: group attached to the boiler but not fully filled; lever: piston group driven by a lever; integrated: group built into a thermoblock or the machine body; other: anything else.

boiler_count.description: Number of boilers, 0 for thermoblock or manual machines.

connectivity.description: Wireless or wired connections for apps or updates: bluetooth, wifi or usb.

burr_mechanism.description: Type of cutting parts. conical: cone-shaped burrs; flat: two flat discs; ghost: flat burrs in a design without a burr carrier contact, sold as "ghost burrs"; roller: industrial-style roller mill; blade: spinning blade that chops rather than grinds; other: anything else.

burr_diameter_mm.description: Diameter of the burrs in millimetres, for example 64 for many flat-burr grinders.

burr_material.description: What the burrs are made of. steel: hardened steel; ceramic: ceramic burrs; titanium_coated: steel with a titanium or similar hard coating; other: anything else.

adjustment_type.description: How grind size is changed. fixed: cannot be changed; stepped: clicks between set positions; stepless: any position in between.

grind_setting_format.description: How the dial reads, so journals can store settings.

grind_setting_min.description: Lowest number on the grind dial, as printed by the maker.

grind_setting_max.description: Highest number on the grind dial, as printed by the maker.

brew_range.description: Brew styles the grinder can grind for, as stated by the maker: espresso, filter or turkish (extra fine).

bean_feed.description: How beans go in. single_dose: weighed dose for each brew; hopper: a container holding beans for many brews; both: works either way.

dose_control_modes.description: How the amount of ground coffee is controlled. manual: the user stops grinding; time: grinds for a set time; weight: stops at a target weight with a built-in scale.

drive.description: manual: turned by hand; electric: driven by a motor.

grind_setting_step.description: Smallest step between settings on a stepped dial.

microns_per_step.description: Burr gap change per setting step, as stated by the maker or measured.

retention_g.description: Ground coffee left inside the grinder after grinding, in grams, as measured or stated by the maker.

rpm_min.description: Lowest motor speed in revolutions per minute.

rpm_max.description: Highest motor speed in revolutions per minute. Equal to rpm_min for fixed-speed grinders.

mechanism.description: How water and coffee meet; matches brew method categories.

capacity_ml.description: Largest amount of brewed coffee it holds or makes at once, in millilitres.

cup_capacity.description: Nominal number of cups the maker states.

material.description: What the brewer is made of; list every material sold under this model, such as ceramic and plastic.

filter_format.description: Filter shape or size, e.g. cone_02, flat_185, chemex_6cup, aeropress_round, metal_mesh.

filter_shape.description: Shape of the filter it uses. cone: pointed cone; flat_bottom: flat base, for example wave filters; basket: basket-shaped paper filter used in drip machines; disc: round disc, as in AeroPress; none: no separate filter.

flow_control.description: How fast water drains. fixed: set by the design; manual_valve: a valve or switch you open and close; programmable: controlled by the machine.

drive.description: manual: you pour or press by hand; electric: a machine heats and pours the water; stovetop: heated on a hob, such as a moka pot.

capacity_ml.description: Largest amount of water it holds, in millilitres.

spout_type.description: gooseneck: thin curved spout for a slow, precise pour; standard: ordinary spout; other: anything else.

temperature_control.description: none: just boils; fixed: a few preset temperatures; adjustable: any temperature in a range can be set.

temperature_min_celsius.description: Lowest temperature that can be set, in degrees Celsius.

temperature_max_celsius.description: Highest temperature that can be set, in degrees Celsius.

supports_temperature_hold.description: Whether the kettle can keep water at the set temperature. true: can hold; false: confirmed cannot hold; absent: unknown.

heat_source.description: electric: has its own heating base; stovetop: heated on a hob; induction_compatible: stovetop kettle that also works on induction hobs; other: anything else.

resolution_g.description: Smallest weight step the display shows, in grams, for example 0.1.

capacity_g.description: Largest weight the scale can measure, in grams.

has_timer.description: Built-in timer. true: has one; false: confirmed none; absent: unknown.

supports_auto_tare.description: Sets itself to zero when a cup or brewer is put on. true: supported; false: confirmed not supported; absent: unknown.

supports_auto_timer.description: Starts the timer by itself when liquid starts to flow or water is poured. true: supported; false: confirmed not supported; absent: unknown.

has_flow_rate_display.description: Shows how fast weight changes, in grams per second. true: shown; false: confirmed not shown; absent: unknown.

connectivity.description: Wireless or wired connections to apps or machines: bluetooth, wifi or usb.

diameter_mm.description: Diameter of the tamper base in millimetres, for example 58.

force_control.description: none: the user decides how hard to press; fixed: a spring gives a set force; adjustable: the spring force can be set.

base_shape.description: Shape of the pressing surface. flat; convex: slightly curved outward; rippled: grooved surface; other: anything else.

self_leveling.description: Whether the tamper sits on the basket rim so it always presses level. true: self-levelling; false: confirmed not self-levelling; absent: unknown.

needle_diameter_mm.description: Thickness of each needle in millimetres, for example 0.3.

depth_control.description: Whether you can limit how deep the needles reach. none: no limit; fixed: set depth; adjustable: depth can be set.

kind.description: single, double or triple: the shot size the basket is made for; other: anything else.

diameter_mm.description: Diameter of the basket in millimetres, for example 58.

nominal_dose_g.description: Dose of ground coffee the basket is designed for, in grams.

pressurized.description: A pressurised basket has a single small exit hole that builds pressure even with a coarse grind. true: pressurised; false: standard unpressurised basket; absent: unknown.

precision.description: A precision basket has tightly controlled hole sizes, sold for consistent extraction. true: precision basket; false: ordinary basket; absent: unknown.

item.title: Equipment model

id.description: Stable readable slug of manufacturer and model, e.g. hario-v60-02. Never reused.

name.description: Full display name, e.g. Hario V60 02.
Brand or company name as printed on the product, for example Hario.

manufacturer_id.description: Reserved for a future manufacturers dataset.

model.description: Model name without the brand, for example V60.

variants.description: Sizes or materials sold under the same model, e.g. 01 and 02, ceramic and plastic.

brew_methods.description: Brew method ids from the Open Coffee brew methods dataset this equipment is made for.

released_year.description: Year the model first went on sale.

discontinued.description: Whether the maker has stopped selling the model. true: discontinued; false: still sold; absent: unknown.

wikidata.description: Wikidata item id of the model or product line, for example Q1234567.

gtin.description: Barcode numbers (GTIN, EAN or UPC; 8 to 14 digits) printed on the packaging, one per variant.

gs1_gpc_brick.description: GS1 Global Product Classification brick code (Wikidata P8957).

weight_g.description: Weight of the product without packaging, in grams.

width.description: Width in millimetres, seen from the front.

depth.description: Depth in millimetres, from front to back.

dimensions_mm.description: Outside size of the product in millimetres.

item.description: Each details object (espresso_machine, grinder, brewer, …) is only allowed for the types it describes.
